naruto.summary: In the Hidden Leaf Village, a young ninja shunned by his peers carries a powerful fox demon sealed inside him at birth. Determined to become Hokage and earn the recognition he has been denied, he grows stronger with his Team 7 teammates through missions and shinobi wars, while trying to bring back a friend who has turned to darkness.

cdesc.Naruto Uzumaki: A warm-hearted orphan ninja, determined to prove his worth despite the village's initial rejection.
cdesc.Sakura Haruno: A gifted medical ninja who stayed in the background for a long time before becoming a formidable fighter.
cdesc.Sasuke Uchiha: An early genius scarred by a family tragedy, he drifts away from the village before an explosive return.
cdesc.Itachi Uchiha: The prodigy of a renowned clan, he carries a heavy secret and acts in the shadows at the cost of his reputation with his little brother.
cdesc.Kakashi Hatake: A copy ninja with a half-masked face, always late but very reliable, he leads the team made up of the hero, Sakura and Sasuke.
cdesc.Jiraiya: An eccentric, flirtatious hermit and part-time writer, he trains the blond hero and deeply believes in peace between peoples.
cdesc.Gaara: A young ninja from the Sand Village, first lonely and feared because of the power inside him, he changes enormously over the story.
cdesc.Rock Lee: A fighter who masters no magic techniques but makes up for it with relentless hard work, boundless energy and unlimited admiration for his master.

one-piece.summary: A young man with a rubber body sets sail to gather a colorful crew and find the legendary treasure of the Pirate King. Every island reveals a new world and new friendships, while his dream of freedom clashes with a sprawling World Government.

cdesc.Monkey D. Luffy: A big-hearted young captain who can stretch his body like rubber.
cdesc.Roronoa Zoro: A formidable swordsman wielding three blades, devoted to becoming the greatest fighter on the seas.
cdesc.Nami: A cunning, money-loving navigator who hides deep loyalty.
cdesc.Sanji: The Straw Hat crew's cook, gallant with women, who fights only with his legs to protect his hands.
cdesc.Usopp: The crew's big-nosed liar and sniper, cowardly on the surface but finds courage to protect his friends.
cdesc.Tony Tony Chopper: A little reindeer who ate a Devil Fruit, he is the crew's adorable doctor and dreams of curing every disease.
cdesc.Nico Robin: A calm, mysterious woman with a dark sense of humor, she studies forbidden ancient texts and has a past full of pursuit.
cdesc.Portgas D. Ace: The hero's adoptive brother, a charismatic captain who controls fire, respected on every sea and very protective of his own.
cdesc.Trafalgar Law: A calculating pirate captain and doctor by trade, he uses a cutting and spatial-swapping power with cold strategic precision.

aot.summary: Humanity survives behind enormous walls, its only protection against man-eating giants. After his hometown is destroyed, a young man joins an elite corps to take revenge, only to discover that the truth about the Titans and the outside world is far more complex than he imagined.
aot.title: Attack on Titan

cdesc.Eren Jaeger: A young soldier driven by a visceral hatred of the Titans, whose destiny goes far beyond revenge.
cdesc.Mikasa Ackerman: An exceptional fighter with absolute devotion to her adoptive brother.
cdesc.Armin Arlert: A cool-headed, analytical soldier whose tactical intelligence makes up for his unathletic body.
cdesc.Levi Ackerman: A neat-freak elite soldier with a cold temper and exceptional strength, he leads a special squad against the giants.
cdesc.Erwin Smith: The charismatic leader of the Survey Corps, ready to make any sacrifice to learn the truth about the world beyond the walls.
cdesc.Hange Zoe: An eccentric, passionate researcher who studies the Titans with overflowing enthusiasm and becomes a key figure in command.
cdesc.Reiner Braun: A seemingly loyal and reliable soldier, torn inside by a conflict between his duty and his friendship with his comrades.
cdesc.Jean Kirstein: A frank, pragmatic young recruit first driven by safety, she matures into a respected leader and often clashes with the hero.
cdesc.Historia Reiss: A young woman who seems gentle on the surface and hides a royal identity, searching for her own worth away from others' expectations.

death-note.summary: A brilliant but jaded high schooler finds a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it. Convinced he can cleanse the world of crime, he becomes a self-proclaimed vigilante, drawn into a battle of wits with a detective determined to stop him.

cdesc.Light Yagami: A gifted student convinced of his own justice, sliding into megalomania.
cdesc.L: An eccentric detective with formidable reasoning, always with a sweet treat within reach.
cdesc.Ryuk: The spirit bound to the notebook, an amused observer of the human consequences of its object.
cdesc.Misa Amane: A model and devoted idol, she loves the hero obsessively and accepts a deal that threatens her own lifespan.
cdesc.Near: A calm young detective who plays with figurines and puzzles, he inherits the mission of hunting the invisible killer.
cdesc.Mello: An impulsive, ambitious heir who doesn't hesitate to use criminal methods, known for his love of chocolate.
cdesc.Soichiro Yagami: The honest, brave chief of the national police, he leads the investigation into the mysterious murders without knowing his own family is involved.
cdesc.Rem: A stern-faced god of death, she protects a human and can change the course of the battle of wits at her own risk.

mha.summary: In a world where most people have a unique power called a Quirk, a boy born without one dreams of becoming the greatest hero. Spotted by the Symbol of Peace, he enters a prestigious academy where he must catch up with overpowered classmates.

cdesc.Izuku Midoriya: A boy born without a power whose perseverance ends up forcing destiny's hand.
cdesc.Katsuki Bakugo: An overpowered, explosive student obsessed with staying the best.
cdesc.Shoto Todoroki: The heir to a dual ice/fire power, in conflict with his father's legacy.
cdesc.All Might: The Symbol of Peace with a dazzling smile, he is the number one hero and passes his legacy to a powerless young student.
cdesc.Ochaco Uraraka: A cheerful, determined classmate who dreams of becoming a hero to help her family financially, with a zero-gravity power.
cdesc.Tenya Iida: A serious, rigorous class rep from a family of heroes, he stands out for the remarkable speed of his legs.
cdesc.Endeavor: The intimidating, ambitious number two hero, he controls flames and must face the consequences of his mistakes toward his family.
cdesc.Tomura Shigaraki: The leader of a league of villains, he disintegrates whatever he touches and harbors a deep hatred of hero society.
cdesc.Eijiro Kirishima: A jovial, loyal student who can harden his body like rock and embodies a manly, chivalrous vision of heroism.

demon-slayer.summary: After his family is slaughtered by a demon, a young charcoal seller sets out to avenge them and save his little sister, who has been turned into a demon. He joins a corps of slayers who use ancestral breathing techniques.

cdesc.Tanjiro Kamado: A rarely kind young man, driven by a heightened sense of smell and an iron will.
cdesc.Nezuko Kamado: Turned into a demon while keeping fragments of her humanity.
cdesc.Zenitsu Agatsuma: A slayer who is fearful day to day but capable of a flash of power in extreme situations.
cdesc.Inosuke Hashibira: An impulsive hunter raised by wild beasts, he wears a boar's head and constantly challenges his companions to duels.
cdesc.Giyu Tomioka: The taciturn, distant Water Hashira, he is the one who set the hero on the path to the slayers.
cdesc.Kyojuro Rengoku: The Flame Hashira with a booming voice, he embodies optimism and a sense of duty, and deeply inspires his companions.
cdesc.Shinobu Kocho: A Hashira with a gentle smile and calm voice, she uses poison and hides deep anger behind her politeness.
cdesc.Muzan Kibutsuji: The first of the demons, the ruthless master of all creatures of the night and the source of the heroes' misfortune.
cdesc.Tengen Uzui: A flamboyant former ninja with an extravagant style, married to three wives, who fights with twin blades.

jjk.summary: An ordinary high schooler swallows a cursed finger to save his friends and unwillingly becomes the host of a feared demonic entity. Recruited by a school of sorcerers, he learns to wield cursed energy while hunting for the creature's other fingers.

cdesc.Yuji Itadori: A high schooler with extraordinary physical strength, now the unwilling host of an evil entity.
cdesc.Megumi Fushiguro: A cold, methodical sorcerer who wields summoning shadows.
cdesc.Satoru Gojo: The most powerful sorcerer of his era, as eccentric as he is feared.
cdesc.Nobara Kugisaki: A blunt sorcerer from the countryside, proud of her explosive temper, who fights with a hammer and enchanted nails.
cdesc.Ryomen Sukuna: The King of Curses, utterly cruel, he lives in the hero's body and wields terrifying power.
cdesc.Maki Zenin: A sorcerer with no cursed energy who fights with weapons and physical strength, determined to surpass her family's traditions.
cdesc.Toge Inumaki: A student who only speaks in rice-ball ingredients, his words can compel anyone who hears them.
cdesc.Kento Nanami: A former office worker tired of corporate life, he returned to sorcery and sticks to a strict schedule with an exemplary sense of duty.
cdesc.Suguru Geto: The strongest sorcerer's former classmate and best friend, he turned to a dark ideology aimed at wiping out non-sorcerers.

chainsaw-man.summary: A young man buried in debt merges with his chainsaw devil dog and becomes a devil hunter with destructive power. Between bloody fights and a search for simple happiness, he navigates a world where devils are born from human fears.

cdesc.Denji: A young man fused with a chainsaw devil, driven by simple desires despite a brutal life.
cdesc.Power: A capricious, boastful blood fiend who hides a sincere attachment to the people close to her.
cdesc.Aki Hayakawa: A serious devil hunter haunted by the loss of his family.
cdesc.Makima: The charismatic head of the devil hunting division, with a fascinating gaze, she manipulates those around her with unsettling calm.
cdesc.Kobeni Higashiyama: A shy young agent terrified of fighting, she always survives dangerous situations despite constant panic.
cdesc.Kishibe: A stern, solitary veteran and formidable devil hunter, he trains new recruits harshly but with some humor.
cdesc.Himeno: A nonchalant, flirtatious agent and chain smoker, she has a contract with a ghost and hides her weariness behind a detached tone.

hxh.summary: A young boy sets out to take the Hunter Exam, the path to a worldwide elite with huge privileges, to find his missing father. His journey leads him through ever stranger trials, alongside friends as gifted as they are endearing.

cdesc.Gon Freecss: A naive, determined boy following in the footsteps of his Hunter father.
cdesc.Killua Zoldyck: The heir to a family of assassins, searching for a life of his own choosing.
cdesc.Kurapika: The last survivor of his clan, driven by a coldly controlled thirst for revenge.
cdesc.Hisoka Morow: An eccentric magician with an unsettling smile, he hunts talented fighters for the thrill of battle and remains unpredictable.
cdesc.Leorio Paradinight: A Hunter Exam candidate motivated by money to become a doctor, he is generous and quickly makes friends.
cdesc.Chrollo Lucilfer: The charismatic leader of a legendary troupe of thieves, he collects stolen powers and inspires absolute loyalty in his members.
cdesc.Netero: The old chairman of the Hunter Association, mischievous and extraordinarily strong, he spent his life perfecting his prayers.
cdesc.Meruem: The king of the Chimera Ants, whose intelligence and power exceed all limits, who gradually opens up to emotions.
cdesc.Illumi Zoldyck: The white-haired hero's older brother, calm and expressionless, a professional assassin who manipulates others with needles.

fmab.summary: Two brothers who tried to bring their mother back with alchemy pay the price by losing their bodies. They travel their country searching for the Philosopher's Stone to recover what they lost, uncovering a far larger national conspiracy.

cdesc.Edward Elric: A young prodigy alchemist who lost an arm and a leg in a failed transmutation.
cdesc.Alphonse Elric: His soul sealed inside a suit of armor, he searches with his brother for a way to get his body back.
cdesc.Roy Mustang: An ambitious State Alchemist who wields flames with formidable precision.
cdesc.Riza Hawkeye: A loyal, reserved sharpshooter, she protects her superior and watches over his conscience throughout their fight.
cdesc.Scar: A scarred warrior with a tattooed arm, he hunts State Alchemists for revenge after seeing his people massacred.
cdesc.Van Hohenheim: The brothers' absent father, a mysterious traveler with a peaceful smile, who holds ancient knowledge about transmutation.
cdesc.Winry Rockbell: The brothers' childhood friend and an automail enthusiast, she repairs the hero's prosthetics with a frank, brave character.
cdesc.King Bradley: The country's respected leader, iron-fisted with a fatherly look, hiding monstrous strength.
cdesc.Maes Hughes: A jovial, talkative officer and devoted father who loves sharing photos of his family, whose fate deeply marks the story.

dbz.summary: A warrior from a vanished planet defends Earth against ever more powerful threats, from alien invaders to artificial creatures. Through extreme training and titanic battles, he builds a lineage of legendary fighters.

cdesc.Son Goku: A big-hearted alien warrior driven by an unquenchable passion for fighting.
cdesc.Vegeta: The fallen prince of a warrior race, proud and obsessed with surpassing Goku.
cdesc.Piccolo: A former enemy turned loyal mentor, able to regenerate his body at will.
cdesc.Son Gohan: The warrior hero's eldest son, a gentle boy with hidden gifts who prefers studying but becomes powerful in the face of danger.
cdesc.Krillin: A small bald warrior and the hero's best friend since childhood, loyal and brave despite lesser abilities.
cdesc.Trunks: A young sword-wielding warrior from the future, son of two key characters, who brings a crucial warning.
cdesc.Freezer: A cruel, elegant galactic tyrant who rules the universe through fear, both polite and ruthless.
cdesc.Cell: An ambitious artificial creature who absorbs his enemies to reach his perfect form and challenges every warrior on Earth.
cdesc.Majin Buu: A childlike, naive and destructive pink creature whose mood changes abruptly and whose power threatens the planet itself.
cdesc.Bulma: A strong-willed genius inventor, she is the hero's best friend and one of the few civilians to join the adventures.

bleach.summary: A high schooler who can see ghosts accidentally inherits the powers of a Soul Reaper and must now protect souls from evil spirits. He discovers a parallel world ruled by strict laws and fearsome hierarchies.

cdesc.Ichigo Kurosaki: A strong-tempered high schooler, now a Substitute Soul Reaper against his will.
cdesc.Rukia Kuchiki: A noble Soul Reaper who passed her powers to Ichigo, discreet but formidable.
cdesc.Renji Abarai: Rukia's childhood friend, a fiery swordsman who becomes a faithful ally.
cdesc.Uryu Ishida: An elegant, proud archer and the last of his clan, he fights with spirit arrows and shows a rivalry with the hero.
cdesc.Orihime Inoue: A sweet, slightly scatterbrained high school girl who uses her hairpins to create shields and heal her friends.
cdesc.Yasutora Sado: A big, quiet high schooler with a big heart, he has a powerful arm and prefers protecting to hitting.
cdesc.Kenpachi Zaraki: A brutal captain who lives for battle, he holds himself back on purpose to give himself a challenge and laughs at every new opponent.
cdesc.Byakuya Kuchiki: A noble, cold captain bound to his family's rules, he wields a sword whose blade scatters into petals.
cdesc.Sosuke Aizen: A smiling, calculating former captain who manipulated everyone for years to carry out an ambitious plan.
cdesc.Toshiro Hitsugaya: A gifted young captain with light hair, serious beyond his years, he wields an ice sword and protects his childhood friend.
cdesc.Kisuke Urahara: An eccentric shopkeeper hidden behind a fan and a hat, a former genius scientist, he helps the hero master his powers.

tokyo-revengers.summary: A young man with no future discovers he can travel back into his own past, to the exact moment his ex-girlfriend was killed by a gang. He then tries to change the course of events to save the people he loved in middle school.

cdesc.Takemichi Hanagaki: An ordinary young man able to travel through time to rewrite his past.
cdesc.Ken Ryuguji dit Draken: The loyal, respected right hand of a biker gang, a protective figure.
cdesc.Manjiro Sano dit Mikey: A charismatic leader whose fate shifts tragically from one timeline to another.
cdesc.Hinata Tachibana: The hero's first love, gentle and brave, her survival is at the heart of the mission that drives him to travel through time.
cdesc.Ryohei Hayashi: The hero's faithful friend, an unexpected gang leader with a big heart and a strong sense of loyalty.
cdesc.Tetta Kisaki: A manipulative, intelligent strategist who maneuvers in the shadows to shift the balance of power between the gangs.
cdesc.Shinichiro Sano: The young leader's admired big brother and the gang's founder, a respected mechanic whose influence deeply marks the story.

spy-x-family.summary: An elite spy must build a fake family for an undercover mission, unaware that his wife is an assassin and his adopted daughter a telepath. Each one hides their secrets from the other two in this family spy comedy.

cdesc.Loid Forger: A cold, methodical secret agent, overwhelmed by the unpredictable dynamics of his fake family.
cdesc.Yor Forger: A formidable assassin leading a double life as a clumsy housewife.
cdesc.Anya Forger: A telepathic child who hides her adoptive parents' secrets, often despite herself.
cdesc.Bond Forger: The family's big white dog who can see the future, seemingly ordinary but quietly very useful to the cover.
cdesc.Yuri Briar: The wife's brother, a zealous employee of the state secret service, he adores his sister to the point of being very intrusive and menacing.
cdesc.Damian Desmond: A politician's son and proud schoolmate, both scornful and secretly drawn to the little telepathic girl.
cdesc.Fiona Frost: A rival spy, discreet and ambitious, she watches warily over the hero she is secretly in love with.

vinland-saga.summary: A young Viking grows up obsessed with revenge after seeing his father killed before his eyes, becoming a fearsome warrior serving his father's murderer. His bloody quest gradually leads him to question the very meaning of war and vengeance.

cdesc.Thorfinn: A young Viking warrior consumed by revenge, searching for meaning in his life.
cdesc.Askeladd: A cunning, charismatic mercenary whose motives are far more complex than they seem.
cdesc.Einar: A pacifist former slave who simply dreams of a peaceful farm life.
cdesc.Thorkell: A cheerful, unpredictable Viking giant who loves fighting stronger opponents and fears boredom more than death.
cdesc.Canute: A young prince who starts out meek and dreamy, he grows into a determined ruler who wants to build a peaceful kingdom.
cdesc.Thors: A legendary former warrior who retired to a quiet life, he teaches his son that true warriors don't need a sword.
cdesc.Leif Ericson: An explorer and teller of legends about a distant land, he fascinates the boy with stories of a country without war.

code-geass.summary: An exiled prince receives the supernatural power to force anyone to obey him and uses it to lead a masked rebellion against the empire that destroyed his family. A brilliant strategist, he wavers between his ideals and the sacrifices his war demands.

cdesc.Lelouch Lamperouge: A fallen prince turned masked strategist, ready to sacrifice anything to avenge his family.
An immortal, enigmatic woman, the source of Lelouch's power.
cdesc.Suzaku Kururugi: Lelouch's childhood friend, an idealist committed to the opposite side of the war.
cdesc.Kallen Stadtfeld: A rebel pilot of mixed heritage, fiery and determined, she leads a double life as a fragile schoolgirl and a resistance fighter.
cdesc.Nunnally Lamperouge: A blind, gentle girl, she is the reason her brother wants to build a kinder world.
cdesc.Euphemia li Britannia: A kind-hearted princess with pacifist ideals, she wants to create a special zone where all peoples can live together.
cdesc.Schneizel el Britannia: A calculating, sophisticated prince, a master of political chess and a formidable opponent for the hero.

fairy-tail.summary: A young wizard joins a colorful mages' guild known for its chaotic missions and the unwavering loyalty of its members. She forms strong friendships while facing rival guilds and ever greater magical threats.

cdesc.Natsu Dragneel: An impulsive fire mage raised by a dragon, searching for his missing father.
cdesc.Lucy Heartfilia: A summoner from a wealthy family who ran away to live her own life.
cdesc.Erza Scarlet: A formidable knight with shifting armor, as strict as she is loyal to her guild.
cdesc.Gray Fullbuster: An ice mage with an annoying habit of losing his clothes, the fiery hero's eternal rival.
cdesc.Happy: A small flying blue cat and the dragon slayer's faithful companion, he loves fish and constantly teases his friends.
cdesc.Gajeel Redfox: A rough-mannered iron dragon slayer, first an opponent, who becomes a faithful guildmate.
cdesc.Makarov Dreyar: The guild's small master, respected for his wisdom and power, who encourages his companions to follow their hearts.

sao.summary: Thousands of players are trapped in a virtual reality game where dying in the game means dying for real. A solo player must climb the floors of a giant dungeon to one day win back their freedom, while protecting the people he meets.

cdesc.Kirito: A solo player turned formidable swordsman, determined to make it out of the deadly game alive.
cdesc.Asuna: An elite fighter and guild vice-commander, as strategic as she is loyal.
cdesc.Klein: An adult player in a bandana, warm and loyal, he becomes a precious friend of the hero from the first days in the game.
cdesc.Sinon: A sniper haunted by her past, she becomes a valuable ally in another online game.
cdesc.Heathcliff: The charismatic leader of a rival guild, he hides a secret tied to the origin of the virtual trap the players are locked in.
cdesc.Yui: A mysterious little girl found by the couple, she is linked to the game's system and brings warmth to the heroes.

haikyu.summary: A short but volleyball-crazy high schooler joins a team that is rebuilding, determined to prove that height isn't everything on the court. This sports series follows the team's technical and collective growth all the way to the national stage.

cdesc.Shoyo Hinata: A short spiker who makes up for it with an incredible jump and boundless energy.
cdesc.Tobio Kageyama: A gifted, demanding setter who becomes Hinata's go-to partner.
cdesc.Kei Tsukishima: A tall, sarcastic, reserved blocker, at first barely motivated by sports, he gradually learns to love the game.
cdesc.Koshi Sugawara: A kind, smiling setter and team veteran, he offers moral support and exemplary team spirit.
cdesc.Tetsuro Kuroo: The mischievous, strategic captain of a rival team, he loves teasing others and shares a peculiar friendship with another captain.
cdesc.Kenma Kozume: The quiet, thoughtful setter of a red team, a video game fan, he watches everything like a strategist in the shadows.

black-clover.summary: In a world where magic determines social status, a boy born with no magic at all still dreams of becoming the most powerful mage in the kingdom. His raw determination and perseverance make him an unexpected rival to far more gifted mages.

cdesc.Asta: A boy without magic who makes up for it with extraordinary physical strength and willpower.
cdesc.Yuno: A prodigy wind mage, Asta's childhood friend and affectionate rival.
cdesc.Noelle Silva: A proud yet shy young noble, she controls water and struggles to escape her family's shadow.
cdesc.Yami Sukehiro: A gruff, smoking captain of impressive power, he leads the Black Bulls squad and inspires a strong sense of loyalty.
cdesc.Julius Novachrono: The kingdom's kind, eccentric ruler, the most powerful mage of his time and very tolerant.
cdesc.Mimosa Vermillion: A gentle, caring plant mage from a royal family, known for her healing skills.
cdesc.Zenon Zogratis: A sadistic, devastating mage serving a cursed people, he takes pleasure in destruction and is by far the most ruthless.

dr-stone.summary: All of humanity is petrified by a mysterious phenomenon for thousands of years. When he wakes up, a science-genius high schooler sets out to rebuild civilization from scratch, relying on the scientific method rather than brute force.

cdesc.Senku Ishigami: A science genius determined to rebuild civilization through science rather than force.
cdesc.Taiju Oki: A loyal, strong friend and the physical engine of the duo despite a simpler mind.
cdesc.Tsukasa Shishio: A young man of colossal strength who wants to build a new world free of corrupt adults, opposed to the hero's scientific ideal.
cdesc.Yuzuriha Ogawa: A sweet, handy girl and cheerful childhood friend, very attached to her loved ones in this stone world.
cdesc.Chrome: A curious, ingenious villager who loves discoveries and becomes one of the first apprentices of the science the hero rebuilds.
cdesc.Kohaku: An agile, brave young warrior from a primitive village, the chief's daughter, who dreams of saving her sick little sister.
cdesc.Gen Asagiri: A sly, manipulative mentalist, always smiling, who switches sides with disconcerting ease and excels at persuasion.
cdesc.Ryusui Nanami: A rich, flamboyant and self-assured adventurer, convinced he is the ideal man to rule the seas of the new stone world.

promised-neverland.summary: In a seemingly idyllic orphanage, a group of gifted children discovers the horrifying truth about their future and plans a meticulous escape against a threat far smarter than they are.

cdesc.Emma: An optimistic, brilliant girl and natural leader of the orphans' escape plan.
cdesc.Norman: A boy with feared strategic genius, a cold calculator in the service of his friends.
cdesc.Ray: A cynical, brilliant boy of formidable intelligence who hides heavy secrets and plans the escape from the orphanage with his friends.
cdesc.Isabella: An elegant, warm caretaker of an orphanage, loved by all the children, whose kindness hides a terrifying reality.
cdesc.Don: An energetic, somewhat boastful boy from the orphanage, loyal to his brothers and sisters and ready to follow them in their escape.
cdesc.Gilda: A diligent, sensitive girl from the orphanage, torn by emotions and doubts but determined to protect the people she loves.
cdesc.Sister Krone: A nun sent as reinforcement, ambitious and cunning, who watches the children closely and seeks to climb the ranks.
cdesc.Phil: A very young boy from the orphanage, innocent and endearing, whose fate deeply worries the older kids and pushes them to act.

rezero.summary: A young man transported to a parallel world discovers that he comes back to life every time he dies, reliving the same events until he finds the right outcome. This isolating power pushes him into ever heavier psychological sacrifices.

cdesc.Subaru Natsuki: A young man transported to another world, doomed to relive death in order to move forward.
cdesc.Emilia: An elf candidate for the throne, kind but rejected because of her appearance.
cdesc.Rem: A devoted maid at the mansion, surprisingly strong with her flail, who becomes deeply attached to the hero despite a hostile start.
cdesc.Ram: A sarcastic, blunt maid and the previous one's twin sister, whose sharp tongue hides unwavering loyalty to her master.
cdesc.Beatrice: A serious, proud little girl who guards a huge secret library and uses magic at an impressive level.
cdesc.Roswaal L. Mathers: A noble magician with clown makeup and theatrical manners, master of a large mansion, whose intentions remain very mysterious.
cdesc.Reinhard van Astrea: An elite knight said to be invincible, adored by the kingdom for his nobility, who bears the weight of almost unfair blessings.
cdesc.Otto Suwen: A somewhat unlucky traveling merchant who can talk to animals and becomes a valuable travel companion for the hero.

steins-gate.summary: An eccentric student accidentally builds a device that can send messages into the past, triggering catastrophic and unforeseen consequences. He must then navigate between world lines to repair what he broke.

cdesc.Rintaro Okabe: An eccentric student convinced he's a mad scientist, faced with the real consequences of his experiments.
cdesc.Kurisu Makise: A brilliant, pragmatic young scientist, skeptical of Okabe's theories.
cdesc.Mayuri Shiina: A sweet, naive and dreamy girl, the hero's childhood friend, whose fate is at the heart of his time-travel quest.
cdesc.Itaru Hashida: A jovial, overweight hacker who loves computers and games, an essential collaborator of the amateur lab in building its strange inventions.
cdesc.Suzuha Amane: A friendly employee of a local shop who hides a heavy secret about her true origins and the future of the world.
cdesc.Ruka Urushibara: A kind young lab member, shy and delicate-looking, who works at his family's Shinto shrine.
cdesc.Faris NyanNyan: A catlike, chatty café waitress, queen of the establishment, who hides a serious share of mystery beneath her cheerful look.
cdesc.Moeka Kiryu: A lonely, silent young woman who communicates almost only by text and whose actions serve a sinister organization.

cowboy-bebop.summary: A crew of jaded bounty hunters roams the solar system aboard their ship, taking job after job and meeting strange characters, with a mix of humor, melancholy and stylish gunfights, all set to jazz.

cdesc.Spike Spiegel: A former crime syndicate member turned jaded bounty hunter and formidable fighter.
cdesc.Jet Black: A pragmatic former cop, captain of the ship and father figure of the crew.
cdesc.Faye Valentine: A debt-ridden gambler with amnesia, seductive and provocative, who joins the ship's crew despite her very independent personality.
cdesc.Edward: An eccentric young computer genius, bouncy and unpredictable, who joins the crew and speaks a language all her own.
cdesc.Ein: A Corgi with abnormally high intelligence who travels with the ship's crew and proves surprisingly useful.
cdesc.Vicious: A formidable syndicate killer, cold and ambitious, armed with a sword, the hero's rival and former friend.
cdesc.Julia: An enigmatic woman at the center of the hero's tormented past, whose fate is tied to the crime syndicate he fled.
cdesc.Gren: A former war soldier turned jaded criminal who seeks revenge by hijacking a dangerous medical treatment.

mob-psycho.summary: A middle schooler with colossal psychic powers tries to live a normal life and suppress his emotions so he never loses control. Working part-time for a fake psychic, he moves between comic absurdity and very real supernatural threats.

cdesc.Shigeo \"Mob\" Kageyama: A middle schooler with immense psychic powers who suppresses his emotions for fear of losing control.
cdesc.Reigen Arataka: A charismatic, smooth-talking fake psychic, Mob's unscrupulous but endearing employer.
cdesc.Ritsu Kageyama: The hero's younger brother, brilliant and serious, who lives in his older brother's shadow and seeks his own strength without such powers.
cdesc.Dimple: A mischievous, manipulative spirit who latches onto the hero, first trying to exploit him before becoming a faithful companion.
cdesc.Teruki Hanazawa: A narcissistic, very popular student with great psychic powers who first takes on the hero before becoming his friend.
cdesc.Toichiro Suzuki: The charismatic, unsettling leader of a secret organization, with immense psychic powers and obsessed with world domination.
cdesc.Katsuya Serizawa: A member of a psychic organization, calm and devoted, who forms a unique bond with the hero and his friends.
cdesc.Tsubomi Takane: A popular student with a strong personality, the hero's friend, who holds an important place in his school life and love life.

assassination-classroom.summary: A class of outcast middle schoolers is given an unlikely mission: assassinate their teacher, an overpowered creature threatening to destroy Earth, before the end of the school year. Between gags and life lessons, an unexpected bond forms.

cdesc.Koro-sensei: An ultra-fast, overpowered creature who, against all odds, becomes a teacher devoted to his students.
cdesc.Nagisa Shiota: A quiet, observant student who reveals an unexpected talent for stalking and assassination.
cdesc.Karma Akabane: An unpredictable, mischievous student, very smart and skilled in combat, who loves trapping his opponents with a sadistic smile.
cdesc.Tadaomi Karasuma: A serious, devoted government agent tasked with overseeing the training of a very unusual class and hunting their teacher.
cdesc.Irina Jelavić: A professional seductress who infiltrates the school to eliminate the target but gradually becomes an endearing teacher.
cdesc.Kaede Kayano: A cheerful student with braided hair who loves desserts and is very attached to the teacher, hiding heavy secrets.
cdesc.Itona Horibe: A silent student whose head is hidden under a bandage, subject to dangerous tentacles, who struggles to fit into the class.
cdesc.Manami Okuda: A shy student brilliant at chemistry, specializing in poisons and concoctions, who takes part in the plans to eliminate the target.

seven-deadly-sins.summary: A princess on the run recruits the scattered members of a legendary order of knights, wrongly accused of treason, to take back her kingdom from a corrupt Holy Knight order. Each member hides an extraordinary power and past.

cdesc.Meliodas: Captain of the Seven Deadly Sins, hiding colossal power behind an easygoing attitude.
cdesc.Elizabeth: A princess determined to save her kingdom, bound to Meliodas by a mysterious fate.
cdesc.Ban: An immortal, cheeky knight, a heavy drinker and faithful companion who wields a fearsome staff and is in love with a fairy.
cdesc.Diane: A cheerful giantess with titanic strength, very attached to her friend, who dreams of a shared love with the captain.
cdesc.King: A childlike fairy and leader of his race, able to control a versatile spirit spear and very affectionate toward his friends.
cdesc.Gowther: A strange, expressionless knight with quirky humor and a power to manipulate minds and memories.
cdesc.Merlin: An ancient magician with almost limitless powers, mysterious and mischievous, whose true goal puzzles even her closest friends.
cdesc.Escanor: A shy, quiet man who turns into a warrior of absolute power and great arrogance under the sunlight.

kaguya-sama.summary: Two top students at an elite high school are in love with each other, but out of sheer pride neither will be the first to confess. What follows is a psychological war as absurd as it is hilarious, where every everyday gesture becomes a strategic battlefield.

cdesc.Kaguya Shinomiya: The heiress of a wealthy family, as brilliant as she is proud, ready to do anything except admit her feelings.
cdesc.Miyuki Shirogane: A model student council president, just as proud and determined not to crack first.
cdesc.Chika Fujiwara: The cheerful, unpredictable student council secretary, a fan of absurd games, who sows confusion despite her innocent looks.
cdesc.Yu Ishigami: The council treasurer, introverted and ironic, once mocked at school, who gradually finds his place among his friends.
cdesc.Miko Iino: A rule-obsessed discipline rep, serious and touchy, who struggles to relax and slowly opens up.
cdesc.Ai Hayasaka: A formidably efficient personal maid and confidante, playful and loyal, who pulls the strings of many comic situations.
cdesc.Kei Shirogane: An outgoing high school girl, the president's little sister, who wants to be liked and never misses a chance to play a prank.
cdesc.Maki Shijo: A strong-willed student from a good family, friend and rival, who speaks frankly and takes an interest in her classmates' love lives.

overlord.summary: When a cult online role-playing game shuts down its servers for good, a lone player finds himself trapped in his character's body: a powerful skeleton sorcerer ruling over a dungeon full of NPCs who now have minds of their own. He sets out to conquer this new world with his loyal army.

cdesc.Ainz Ooal Gown: A former player turned overpowered skeleton lord, trying to hide his flaws behind icy authority.
cdesc.Albedo: A demonic guardian devoted body and soul to her master, as formidable in battle as she is unpredictable.
cdesc.Shalltear Bloodfallen: A formidable vampire and floor guardian with an explosive temper, who boundlessly admires her master and competes with the other guardians.
cdesc.Demiurge: An intelligent, sadistic demon and floor guardian who orchestrates Machiavellian plans for his master with chilling calm.
cdesc.Cocytus: A gigantic, honorable insect warrior who guards an ice floor and enjoys fair duels and noble fights.
cdesc.Sebas Tian: An impeccably elegant dragon butler with a strict code of honor and a softer heart than the rest of his kind.
cdesc.Aura Bella Fiora: An energetic, playful young dark elf and monster tamer who guards her floor alongside her twin brother.
cdesc.Mare Bello Fiore: A shy, reserved young dark elf and powerful mage who guards his floor alongside his twin sister and lacks confidence.

tensei-slime.summary: An office worker killed by accident is reincarnated in a fantasy world as a simple slime. With formidable absorption powers, he gradually founds a thriving nation where humans and monsters live together in peace.

cdesc.Rimuru Tempest: A former salaryman reincarnated as a slime, now the charismatic leader of a nation of monsters.
cdesc.Benimaru: A hot-blooded ogre general with unwavering loyalty to Rimuru.
cdesc.Veldora Tempest: A storm dragon imprisoned for centuries, talkative and proud, who befriends the hero and advises him from his seal.
cdesc.Milim Nava: A childlike demon lord, extremely powerful and capricious, who finds everything amusing and considers the hero a friend.
cdesc.Shion: An imposing, devoted ogre woman and loyal secretary to a leader, whose energy and strength contrast with her dubious cooking.
cdesc.Shuna: A gentle, delicate ogre princess skilled in cooking and crafts, who takes care of the people of the hero's city.
cdesc.Souei: A discreet, efficient ogre ninja in charge of intelligence and stealth, who follows orders with absolute loyalty.
cdesc.Diablo: An elegant, manipulative demon who swears loyalty to the hero, with terrifying strength and an all-consuming worship of his master.

konosuba.summary: An otaku teenager dies in a ridiculous way and is offered a second life in a fantasy world, along with a clumsy goddess he picked himself. Together they form an adventuring party as incompetent as it is lovable, stumbling from one hilarious disaster to the next.

cdesc.Kazuma Sato: A jaded former Japanese shut-in, pragmatic to the point of cowardice when facing the dangers of his new world.
cdesc.Aqua: A capricious, incompetent goddess, banished to the world for laughing at Kazuma's death.
cdesc.Megumin: A young wizard obsessed with one overpowered spell she can only cast once a day.
cdesc.Darkness: A noble knight, an openly masochistic tank with remarkable defense, who dreams of being roughed up and almost never hits her target.
cdesc.Wiz: A gentle, clumsy lich who runs a magic shop, too kind to be scary despite being undead.
cdesc.Yunyun: A shy young mage looking for friendship, rival of one of the heroines, who suffers from loneliness and stumbles into awkward situations.
cdesc.Vanir: An extravagant demon who loves tormented souls and pranks, able to read deep desires, and who almost never tries to kill.
cdesc.Eris: A kind, serious goddess worshiped by many believers, in sharp contrast with the hero's goddess.

shield-hero.summary: Summoned to a parallel world as one of four legendary heroes, a young man is given the weakest-looking weapon of all: a simple shield. Betrayed and slandered from the start, he must rebuild his reputation by developing new defensive strategies.

cdesc.Naofumi Iwatani: The Shield Hero, unjustly betrayed, hardened by adversity and determined to protect those who trust him.
cdesc.Raphtalia: A former demi-human slave turned formidable warrior, deeply loyal to Naofumi.
cdesc.Filo: A creature that looks like a giant bird, naive and cheerful, who can take a childlike form and loves eating and pulling the cart.
cdesc.Melty Melromarc: A smart, brave young princess, loyal to the Shield Hero, who stands against corruption within her own family.
cdesc.Malty Melromarc: A manipulative princess who falsely accuses the Shield Hero and deeply wounds him, with a limitless thirst for power.
cdesc.Motoyasu Kitamura: An arrogant, naive hero armed with a spear, easily seduced and blinded by his own convictions.
cdesc.Ren Amaki: A lonely, proud hero armed with a sword, who acts alone and prefers to fight without anyone's help.
cdesc.Itsuki Kawasumi: An idealistic hero armed with a bow, obsessed with his own vision of justice, who judges others too quickly.

one-punch-man-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the cult manga: a hero so strong he beats any opponent with a single punch is bored to death for lack of a real challenge. A hilarious parody of superhero tropes, driven by spectacular animation.

cdesc.Saitama: An overpowered, jaded hero desperately looking for an opponent worthy of him.
cdesc.Genos: A determined cyborg, Saitama's admiring disciple and faithful ally.
cdesc.Garou: A young man obsessed with monsters who calls himself the enemy of heroes and seeks to become the strongest through martial arts.
cdesc.Tatsumaki: A powerful S-class esper who looks like a little girl, with monstrous telekinetic powers, bossy, impulsive and very proud.
cdesc.Fubuki: A charismatic B-class heroine who leads a group of heroes, loves power and confidently manipulates her underlings.
cdesc.Mumen Rider: A hero with no powers and no real strength who bravely fights on his bicycle, believing in justice at the risk of his life.
cdesc.Bang: An S-class martial arts master renowned for his legendary technique and sense of justice, who looks after students.
cdesc.King: An S-class hero said to be invincible, famous for his imposing presence, though the reality is quite different.

tokyo-ghoul-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the manga: an ordinary student is turned into a half-human, half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter, forcing him to navigate a hidden world where ghouls feed on humans while fighting to keep his humanity.

cdesc.Ken Kaneki: A student turned half-human, half-ghoul, whose identity fractures over the course of the story.
cdesc.Touka Kirishima: A protective ghoul hiding her vulnerability behind an explosive temper.
cdesc.Hideyoshi Nagachika: The hero's cheerful, perceptive best friend, who keeps supporting him and knows more than he lets on.
cdesc.Rize Kamishiro: A seductive, cultured young woman whose meeting with the hero turns his life upside down and changes him forever.
cdesc.Kishou Arima: A legendary Commission investigator, calm and melancholic, considered the most powerful fighter against ghouls.
cdesc.Juuzou Suzuya: An eccentric, unpredictable investigator covered in scars, with a traumatic past, who wields his weapon with strange pleasure.
cdesc.Shuu Tsukiyama: A refined, eccentric ghoul who collects rare meals, obsessed with one particular flavor and very attached to his status.
cdesc.Ayato Kirishima: The heroine's younger brother and rival, impulsive and violent, a member of a ghoul organization defying the authorities and his own family.

blue-lock-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the manga: after a painful World Cup defeat, the Japanese football federation locks three hundred promising strikers inside a ruthless training center, where only one will survive to become the selfish goal scorer the national team needs.

cdesc.Yoichi Isagi: A striker haunted by a past failure, forced to redefine his playstyle to survive the program.
cdesc.Meguru Bachira: An unpredictable, creative striker with fancy dribbles, who says he has a monster inside him and plays with infectious joy.
cdesc.Seishiro Nagi: A striker with natural talent and exceptional ball control, laid-back and lazy, who struggles to find real motivation.
cdesc.Reo Mikage: The son of a wealthy heir, versatile and sociable, who bonds with a teammate and wants to become his best support.
cdesc.Rin Itoshi: A football prodigy of superior talent, cold and distant, driven by boundless ambition and a tense relationship with his brother.
cdesc.Jinpachi Ego: An eccentric, provocative coach who runs an extreme program to create the most selfish striker in the world.
cdesc.Michael Kaiser: An arrogant German striker with terrifying shooting power, considered a genius and very proud.
cdesc.Shoei Barou: A striker with the attitude of a king and a predator's instinct, who imposes his will on the pitch with raw power.

violet-evergarden.summary: A former child soldier, shaped for war and cut off from her emotions, becomes a ghostwriter after the conflict. By writing letters for others, she slowly tries to understand the meaning of the words her former commander said to her before he vanished.

cdesc.Violet Evergarden: A former child soldier with mechanical arms, seeking the meaning of human feelings through writing.
cdesc.Gilbert Bougainvillea: Violet's former commander, whose last words haunt and guide her quest.
cdesc.Claudia Hodgins: A former war comrade and head of the postal company, caring and loyal, who watches over the heroine like family.
cdesc.Cattleya Baudelaire: An elegant, very self-assured colleague and refined Auto Memory Doll, who loves romance and readily advises her friends.
cdesc.Benedict Blue: A serious, orderly-looking colleague devoted to the company, who wants to do his job well and scolds the clumsy ones.
cdesc.Iris Cannary: A lively young Auto Memory Doll who loves romance, dreaming of love and of writing heartfelt letters for her clients.
cdesc.Erica Brown: A beginner young playwright, enthusiastic and ambitious, who dreams of writing great plays with the heroine's help.
cdesc.Dietfried Bougainvillea: A strict, demanding officer from an influential family, deeply at odds with his younger brother, whose resentment softens over time.

your-lie-in-april.summary: A young piano prodigy who can no longer play since a trauma linked to his mother has his life turned upside down by an eccentric, vibrant violinist. She gradually helps him learn to feel music, and to live, again.

cdesc.Kousei Arima: A piano prodigy paralyzed by the trauma of losing his mother, unable to hear the sound of his own playing.
cdesc.Kaori Miyazono: A flamboyant, unpredictable violinist who restores Kousei's love of music and of life.
cdesc.Tsubaki Sawabe: The hero's energetic, sporty childhood friend, brusque but tender, who struggles with her feelings and always stays by his side.
cdesc.Ryota Watari: The hero's best friend, athletic and very popular with girls, cheerful and loyal, with a sincere heart.
cdesc.Emi Igawa: A talented, determined pianist who has admired the hero since childhood and dreams of facing him in a competition.
cdesc.Takeshi Aiza: An ambitious, hard-working pianist and the hero's rival, who has set himself the goal of surpassing him and earning his recognition.
cdesc.Nagi Aiza: A pianist's lively, energetic younger sister who admires a talent and wants to learn to play at a high level.

toradora.summary: A high schooler with a delinquent's face but a homemaker's heart teams up with the most feared girl in his class so they can help each other win over the people they love. An unlikely friendship slowly turns into something deeper.

cdesc.Ryuji Takasu: A high schooler with an intimidating face but a gentle, homebody nature, often misjudged by his looks.
cdesc.Taiga Aisaka: A tiny high school girl with an explosive temper nicknamed the "Palmtop Tiger", hiding deep loneliness.
cdesc.Minori Kushieda: An energetic, sporty high school girl with a quirky mood, who hides her true feelings behind a constant smile and infectious cheer.
cdesc.Ami Kawashima: A famous model with an angelic face but a sharp tongue, frank and perceptive with the people she likes.
cdesc.Yusaku Kitamura: The serious, bespectacled student council president, a faithful, diligent friend with slightly awkward humor.
cdesc.Yasuko Takasu: A young, carefree single mother working at a night bar, full of love for her son despite her scatterbrained ways.
cdesc.Sumire Kano: The beautiful student council president, loved by all and popular for her seriousness and talents.

fruits-basket.summary: An orphaned high school girl taken in by a mysterious family discovers that some of its members turn into animals of the Chinese zodiac whenever they are hugged by someone of the opposite sex. Her kindness gradually heals the deep wounds of this cursed family.

cdesc.Tohru Honda: An orphaned high school girl of unshakable kindness, whose presence turns the family that takes her in upside down.
cdesc.Kyo Sohma: A zodiac member with an explosive temper, consumed by rejection and the curse of the Cat.
cdesc.Yuki Sohma: A quietly charming zodiac member who carries the weight of an envied status he never wanted.
cdesc.Shigure Sohma: A mischievous, enigmatic novelist who hosts the heroine, always smiling, whose humor hides troubling intentions and a troubled past.
cdesc.Akito Sohma: The feared head of a cursed family, unpredictable and authoritarian, whose hold over his relatives is as cruel as it is fascinating.
cdesc.Hatsuharu Sohma: A gentle, calm boy who can turn violent and aggressive when he loses his cool, and who stays very loyal to those around him.
cdesc.Kagura Sohma: A fiery girl in love, impulsive and impressively strong, who is very attached to Kyo.
cdesc.Arisa Uotani: A former delinquent with a fiery temper and the heroine's loyal friend, always ready to fight to protect those she loves.
cdesc.Saki Hanajima: A mysterious girl dressed in black with a strange sense of "waves", very attached to the heroine and her friends.

evangelion.summary: In a future ravaged by disasters, a teenager is reluctantly recruited to pilot a giant biomechanical robot against mysterious beings threatening humanity. Behind the spectacular battles lies a deep dive into the fractured psychology of its young pilots.

cdesc.Shinji Ikari: An introverted teenager forced by his distant father to pilot an Evangelion, searching for recognition.
cdesc.Rei Ayanami: An enigmatic, detached pilot whose past hides a heavy secret.
cdesc.Asuka Langley: A prodigy pilot with a proud, competitive temper, hiding deep inner fragility.
cdesc.Misato Katsuragi: NERV's energetic, outspoken major, she guides the pilots in battle while hiding her own wounds behind a cheerful front.
cdesc.Gendo Ikari: NERV's cold, manipulative commander, he pursues a secret plan at the cost of his relationship with his own son.
cdesc.Kaworu Nagisa: A mysterious, gentle pilot who appears late in the series and forms a moving bond with the hero.
cdesc.Ritsuko Akagi: NERV's brilliant head of science, who holds deep resentment toward her own mother and her superior.
cdesc.Toji Suzuhara: The hero's fiery, loyal classmate, who fights to protect his hospitalized little sister.

jojo.summary: Across several generations of the same cursed family, the saga follows various heirs of the Joestar name in their fights against supernatural forces, using spiritual manifestations called Stands. A flamboyant visual style unique in the shonen landscape.

cdesc.Jotaro Kujo: A taciturn high schooler with an overpowered Stand, as phlegmatic as he is formidable in battle.
cdesc.Dio Brando: The sworn enemy of the Joestar family for generations, as charismatic as he is ruthless.
cdesc.Joseph Joestar: A cunning, talkative adventurer, as good at fighting as at dodging blows by cheating.
cdesc.Jean Pierre Polnareff: An exuberant, vain French swordsman who joins the journey to Egypt to avenge his murdered sister.
cdesc.Muhammad Avdol: A calm, wise Egyptian fortune teller who controls flames with his Stand and guides the group of travelers.
cdesc.Noriaki Kakyoin: An elegant red-haired high schooler, first manipulated by an enemy, who becomes the group's loyal strategist.
cdesc.Giorno Giovanna: An ambitious young boy from Naples who dreams of becoming a big-hearted gangster and cleaning up the underworld.
cdesc.Josuke Higashikata: A Morioh high schooler with a pompadour, very protective of his friends, whose Stand can repair objects.
cdesc.Yoshikage Kira: A discreet Morioh serial killer who dreams of a quiet life and hides his crimes behind the look of an office worker.

made-in-abyss.summary: In a world where a giant, unexplored chasm holds treasures as well as unspeakable horrors, a young orphan girl descends into its depths to find her missing mother, accompanied by a mysterious human-looking robot.

cdesc.Riko: A young explorer determined to find her mother at the risk of her life, driven by sometimes reckless courage.
cdesc.Reg: An amnesiac humanoid robot with an arm capable of unsuspected destructive power.
cdesc.Nanachi: A rabbit-like creature living deep in the chasm, wary at first, who then travels with the heroes with great tenderness.
cdesc.Ozen: A formidable, unpredictable White Whistle of the Guild, nicknamed the Immovable, who tests young adventurers with strange brutality.
cdesc.Bondrewd: A science-obsessed White Whistle, polite and warm on the surface, who nonetheless carries out cruel experiments on children.
cdesc.Lyza: A legendary adventurer lost in the depths, whose legacy and mystery drive her daughter to descend into the abyss.

erased.summary: A young manga artist with the power to go back a few minutes in time before a tragedy is suddenly sent eighteen years into the past, to the time of an unsolved child kidnapping case. He must solve the case before it happens again.

cdesc.Satoru Fujinuma: A manga artist with an involuntary time-rewind power, determined to change a tragic past.
cdesc.Kayo Hinazuki: Satoru's quiet childhood classmate, at the heart of the mystery he is trying to solve.
cdesc.Airi Katagiri: The hero's classmate, earnest and kind, who helps him defend his friends in danger.
cdesc.Sachiko Fujinuma: The hero's brave mother, a journalist by trade with a formidable instinct, protective of her son.
cdesc.Kenya Kobayashi: The hero's smart, loyal classmate, nicknamed the group's leader, with a very sharp deductive mind.
cdesc.Gaku Yashiro: A teacher adored by his students, charismatic and seemingly flawless, but whose true nature is chilling.

hells-paradise.summary: A ninja sentenced to death is offered a chance at a pardon: explore a mysterious island in search of an elixir of immortality for the shogun, alongside other criminals and their executioners. The island teems with supernatural creatures and dangers far more terrifying than expected.

cdesc.Gabimaru: A ninja nicknamed "the Hollow", unable to feel fear, looking for a reason to survive and return to his wife.
cdesc.Sagiri Asaemon: An official executioner tasked with watching Gabimaru, as formidable with a sword as she is upright in her principles.
cdesc.Yuzuriha: A cautious, endearing kunoichi, once a ruthless killer, who can barely stand violence but fights to survive on the island.
cdesc.Mei: The twin of a fearsome creature of the island, whose grace and serenity hide strength far beyond any human's.
cdesc.Tao Fu: The master of the mysterious island, who handles qi with ease and puts balance above all else.
cdesc.Nurugai: A sadistic, sneering convict whose taste for carnage and unsettling smile make him very dangerous.

mushoku-tensei.summary: A 34-year-old Japanese shut-in, killed in an accident, is reincarnated in a world of magic as a baby, keeping all his memories. Determined not to waste this second chance, he resolves to live life to the fullest, with no regrets this time.

cdesc.Rudeus Greyrat: A former shut-in reincarnated as a magic prodigy, determined to live his new life without the regrets of the old one.
cdesc.Roxy Migurdia: An expert Migurd mage, Rudeus's tutor and an early figure of admiration for him.
cdesc.Eris Boreas Greyrat: A young sword-wielding noble, impulsive and proud, whose explosive temper hides a loyal heart toward her tutor.
cdesc.Sylphiette: A shy, quiet green-haired half-elf whom a young boy rescues from the bullies of her village.
cdesc.Paul Greyrat: The hero's dissolute but endearing swordsman father, who clumsily tries to raise him well while fighting his own flaws.
cdesc.Orsted: A dragon god feared by all, he offers the hero his help against a threat looming over the world.
cdesc.Ghislaine Dedoldia: A beastly warrior of great strength and former renowned swordswoman, who becomes the young hero's escort.
cdesc.Zenith Greyrat: The hero's gentle, loving mother and an experienced healer, who welcomed him unconditionally into his new life.

apothecary-diaries.summary: In imperial China, a young apothecary sold as a servant to the palace uses her knowledge of herbs to solve the mysteries and poisonous intrigues shaking the court, while trying not to draw too much attention.

cdesc.Maomao: A pragmatic apothecary with a passion for poisons, solving the palace's mysteries with delightful detachment.
cdesc.Jinshi: A strikingly beautiful high official, intrigued by Maomao's sharp mind.
cdesc.Gaoshun: His master's stoic, devoted assistant, who watches the heroine's palace investigations with amusement.
cdesc.Lakan: An eccentric strategist with a monocle, a genius at games who hates constraints, mysteriously tied to the heroine's world.
cdesc.Gyokuyou: An imperial consort with quiet charm, who places her trust in the heroine after she saves her child's life.
cdesc.Lihua: A dazzlingly beautiful imperial concubine who suffers from a secret tied to poison in the palace's cosmetics.
cdesc.Pairin: A renowned courtesan of the pleasure district who has watched over the heroine since she was very young.

bocchi-the-rock.summary: A high school guitarist with crazy talent but crippling social anxiety dreams of joining a band without ever having had the courage to talk to anyone. Her chaotic arrival in an existing band turns her reclusive life upside down.

cdesc.Hitori Gotoh: A gifted guitarist with extreme social anxiety who gradually blossoms through music.
cdesc.Nijika Ijichi: An enthusiastic, sociable drummer and the band's kind driving force.
cdesc.Ryo Yamada: The band's eccentric, detached bassist, who lives in poverty and sometimes eats odd things to save money.
cdesc.Ikuyo Kita: An outgoing, popular guitarist who hides a fear of not being good enough and joins the band by chance.
cdesc.Seika Ijichi: The cool, laid-back manager of the live house, who supports the band while hiding her generosity behind sarcastic remarks.
cdesc.Kikuri Hiroi: A whimsical, alcoholic bassist from another band who is often drunk but reveals surprising musical talent.

oshi-no-ko.summary: A gynecologist who is a fan of a popular idol ends up delivering her twins, then dies and is reborn as one of her own children. He then discovers, from the inside, the ruthless and sometimes criminal backstage of the Japanese entertainment industry.

cdesc.Ai Hoshino: An adored idol hiding a heavy secret and deep loneliness behind her perfect smile.
cdesc.Aqua Hoshino: A former gynecologist reborn as Ai's son, driven by a coldly calculated desire for revenge.
cdesc.Ruby Hoshino: The hero's energetic, determined twin sister, who dreams of becoming an idol worthy of her mother.
cdesc.Kana Arima: A former child star with a strong personality, who carries pride mixed with worry about fading in the business.
cdesc.Akane Kurokawa: An analytical, perceptive actress who befriends the hero thanks to her sharp sense of observation and deduction.
cdesc.MEMcho: A quirky young influencer and idol, very funny and determined, who joins the main group along the way.
cdesc.Taishi Gotanda: A quiet, reserved showbiz director who treats young talent with a mix of seriousness and kindness.

dandadan.summary: A high school girl who believes in ghosts and a classmate convinced aliens exist challenge each other to prove their beliefs, and end up dragged into an adventure where both turn out to be very real.

cdesc.Momo Ayase: An impulsive high school girl who believes in ghosts and has unsuspected psychic powers.
cdesc.Ken Takakura: An otaku classmate nicknamed "Okarun", obsessed with aliens and the paranormal.
cdesc.Turbo Granny: The vengeful, mischievous spirit of an old woman who loves tormenting the heroes but ends up growing attached to them.
cdesc.Aira Shiratori: A classmate with a sultry charm, first an enemy, who becomes a loyal ally with unusual spiritual powers.
cdesc.Seiko Ayase: The heroine's bossy medium grandmother, who holds spiritual powers and is very protective of her granddaughter.
cdesc.Jin Enjoji: A strange boy fascinated by the occult who helps his friends with a peculiar air of self-importance.

ranking-of-kings.summary: A small, deaf young prince, underestimated by his whole kingdom because of his disability, still dreams of becoming the greatest king in history. With a mysterious shadow who has become his loyal friend, he learns to turn his apparent weaknesses into strengths.

cdesc.Bojji: A small, deaf young prince, underestimated by those around him but driven by boundless kindness and determination.
cdesc.Kage: A mysterious shadow who becomes Bojji's faithful companion, hiding a heavy past.
cdesc.Daida: The hero's younger half-brother, a gifted, well-trained swordsman convinced his older brother is unworthy of the throne.
cdesc.Hiling: The hero's stepmother, a dutiful mother who sees the crown as her own son's future.
cdesc.Domas: The kingdom's master-at-arms, a loyal veteran in the king's service who trains the princes demandingly.
cdesc.Miranjo: The queen of a cursed kingdom with hypnotic power, whose arrogance and cruelty betray a deep wound.
cdesc.Bosse: A feared and respected king who was once the strongest of all and left an ambiguous legacy to his sons.

devilman-crybaby.summary: A pure-hearted teenager merges with a demon to fight demons from within, keeping his humanity despite terrifying destructive strength. A dark, visceral reimagining of a classic, about the loss of innocence and human cruelty.

cdesc.Akira Fudo: A teenager of boundless empathy, fused with a demon while miraculously keeping his humanity.
cdesc.Ryo Asuka: Akira's cold, calculating childhood friend, hiding far greater motives.
cdesc.Miki Makimura: A sporty, warm and protective high school girl who stays loyal to her childhood friend despite the chaos around her.
cdesc.Miko Kuroda: A sweet, bubbly member of the track team, part of the heroine's inner circle.
cdesc.Kaim: A rival demon first hostile to the hero, who ends up allying with him, driven by a peculiar code of honor.
cdesc.Sirene: A female demon of icy, manipulative beauty who thrives on her power of seduction.
cdesc.Jinmen: A human-faced demon with a cruel temper who delights in spreading terror.

samurai-champloo.summary: Two swordsmen with completely opposite styles are saved from execution by a young waitress, and in return they promise to help her find a mysterious samurai who smells of sunflowers. A picaresque road trip through feudal Japan, set to hip-hop.

cdesc.Mugen: A wild swordsman with an unpredictable breakdance-inspired fighting style, as impulsive as he is elusive.
cdesc.Jin: An austere, disciplined ronin who wields a classical swordsmanship technique with formidable precision.
cdesc.Fuu: A determined young waitress who enlists the two swordsmen in her search for a mysterious samurai.
cdesc.Kariya Kagetoki: A ruthless, ambitious master swordsman who pursues the heroes with cold, methodical persistence.
cdesc.Manzo the Saw: An exuberant saw-wielding bandit who crosses paths with the heroes several times with comedy and flair.

golden-kamuy-anime.summary: The anime adaptation of the manga: in early 20th-century Hokkaido, a hardened war veteran teams up with a young Ainu girl to find a hidden gold treasure whose location is tattooed on the skin of escaped prisoners.

cdesc.Frieren: A near-immortal elf mage who belatedly faces the weight of time slipping away from her human companions.

cdesc.Holo: A centuries-old wolf goddess in the form of a young woman, as shrewd in business as she is sentimental.

hyouka.summary: An energy-conserving high schooler reluctantly joins his school's classic literature club, where a classmate's insatiable curiosity drags him into solving small everyday school mysteries.

cdesc.Yuzuru Otonashi: An amnesiac young man who joins a high school outside of time and is gradually brought back to his memories and feelings.

According to a prophecy, Noriko has the power to unleash that evil. Bound together, they must cross a world as wondrous as it is hostile. An adaptation of Kyoko Hikawa's cult shojo.

cdesc.Izark Kia Tarj: A wandering swordsman, the reincarnation of the Sky Demon.
cdesc.Noriko Tachiki: An ordinary high school girl, the "Awakening" of the prophecy.

uncle-s-obsession-with-cute-things.summary: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret love of all things cute. But an unexpected encounter threatens to blow his double life wide open. A sweet comedy.

cdesc.Mitsutaka Oji: A handsome section manager and secret fan of the mascot Pugtaro.

vertex-force.summary: Akira lives peacefully in Okinawa with his sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a café. But the family hides a secret: Haruka inherited a power called "Engine" from their father. Akira didn't, and it eats at him. Meanwhile, strange events break out around the world. An original mecha series.

cdesc.Akira Toudou: A middle schooler with a strong sense of justice, insecure about having no power.
cdesc.Haruka Toudou: Akira's cheerful, athletic sister, heir to the "Engine" power.

ace-of-the-diamond-act-ii-second-season.summary: The sequel to Ace of the Diamond act II. Eijun Sawamura and the Seido High baseball team keep fighting their way to Koshien, with ever fiercer rivalries.

cdesc.Eijun Sawamura: A fiery left-handed pitcher from Nagano.
cdesc.Kazuya Miyuki: Seido's brilliant catcher and team captain.

welsh-shedar.summary: Welsh, a country boy who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince destined to rule, cross paths by chance. Together they must stop a cruel tyrant from conquering the world. A fantasy adventure set in the Dofus universe.

cdesc.Welsh: A cheerful boy and gifted cook from Broccoli Village.
cdesc.Shedar: The brilliant, level-headed prince of the Kingdom of Bonta.

tetsuryo-meet-with-tetsudou-musume.summary: Misaki often dreams of leaving everything behind to travel far away. At university, she meets the Railway Travel Research Club, the "Tetsuryo Club". As her world unfolds along the railway lines, her heart starts racing. A gentle series for Tetsudou Musume's 20th anniversary.

cdesc.Misaki Sata: A first-year student new to trains, searching for a passion.

girls-und-panzer-motto-love-love-sakusen.summary: The daily lives of the Ooarai girls and the other schools devoted to the way of the tank, in a slice-of-life comedy spin-off of Girls und Panzer.

cdesc.Miho Nishizumi: Commander of Ooarai's tank team, from a renowned family.

hotel-inhumans-season-2.summary: Season two. At Hotel Inhumans, a hotel for assassins only, Ikuro, a concierge who hates violence, and Sara, his cold and formidable colleague, keep catering to the requests of very unusual guests.

cdesc.Ikurou Hoshi: A concierge who hates blood, lost in a hotel for assassins.
cdesc.Sara Haizaki: A veteran concierge, calm, ruthless and fearsome in a fight.

dandivine.summary: Twenty years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll, the world is at peace, and the toy maker Kasuga, which lived off its merchandise, is in decline. Its president prays for Dandivine's return... and the Aposdoll come back. High schooler Gekiha is invited to pilot the giant robot.

cdesc.Gekiha Shijima: A high schooler invited to pilot the giant robot Dandivine.

dark-machine-the-animation.summary: Following his grandfather's last wish to "seek out the Senki", Kairi travels to Golden Valley, a special economic zone built around Dark Machines. There he meets Rudra, a mysterious girl who drags him into becoming a pilot, and his talent blossoms through intense battles.

cdesc.Kairi: A young man following his grandfather's last wish.

umayuru-full-gate.summary: A series of short episodes featuring pint-sized Uma Musume. This time, it's a three-minute race where all the Uma Musume hit the track together, in a laid-back, funny atmosphere.

cdesc.Special Week: A pure-hearted runner from Hokkaido, full of dreams.

with-vengeance-sincerely-your-broken-sai.summary: Season two. Lua, a betrayed and scarred saint who was sentenced to death before going back in time, continues her revenge against those who betrayed her, alongside Prince Sven.

cdesc.Lua: A betrayed, scarred saint who went back in time for revenge.

battle-spirits-re-zekkai-no-ku.summary: Japan, at the end of the Edo period. Young Kuu Bashin dreams of growing stronger through Battle Spirits. cdesc.Ku Bashin: A young boy who dreams of growing strong through Battle Spirits.
cdesc.Zetsu Ajara: A wandering samurai and formidable battler.

keroro.summary: Sergeant Keroro, an alien frog, comes to conquer Earth... but gets captured and ends up living with the Hinata family. The cult comedy returns in a new series.

cdesc.Keroro: An alien sergeant sent to invade Earth, and a model-kit fanatic.
cdesc.Fuyuki Hinata: The Hinata family's son, a fan of the supernatural and Keroro's friend.

the-prince-of-tennis-ii-u-17-world-cup-f.summary: Old rivalries reignite as Team Japan's players face off to earn their spots in the U-17 World Cup final.

cdesc.Ryoma Echizen: A young tennis prodigy with extraordinary talent.

magical-sisters-luluttolilly-part-2.summary: The second half of Magical Sisters LuluttoLilly. Sisters Fuu and Rui transform into idol magical girls and continue their adventures in song.

cdesc.Fuu Nonoyama: A cheerful, spontaneous schoolgirl, always the center of attention.
cdesc.Rui Nonoyama: Her serious, quiet big sister, who used to love singing.

berserk.summary: A lone mercenary carries a huge sword and a consuming hatred for his former friend, responsible for a sacrifice that destroyed his life. He travels through a dark medieval world haunted by demons, on an endless quest for revenge.
berserk.author: Kentaro Miura

vagabond.summary: Inspired by the life of the famous swordsman Musashi Miyamoto, this manga follows his journey from a violent, lost young man to the search for a true way of the sword, through duels and life-changing encounters.
vagabond.author: Takehiko Inoue

cdesc.Sasaki Kojiro: A genius swordsman whose fate is intertwined with Musashi's.

cdesc.Baiken Shishido: A master of the chain-sickle, a dangerous opponent of the hero, formidable with an unusual weapon.

vinland-saga-manga.summary: The original work behind the anime of the same name, taking the story of young Viking Thorfinn much further in his quest for revenge and then redemption, with even greater historical and philosophical depth.
vinland-saga-manga.author: Makoto Yukimura

chainsaw-man-manga.summary: The original Chainsaw Man, with its author's signature dark humor and graphic violence, follows Denji into a second part that explores new characters and a more introspective plot.

cdesc.Kobeni Higashiyama: A clumsy, terrified new hunter, yet blessed with luck and stamina that save her in perilous situations.
cdesc.Reze: A smiling, discreet café worker whose charm hides formidable combat and spying skills.

jjk-manga.summary: The complete original Jujutsu Kaisen, including the entire final arc not yet covered by the anime when it aired, where the stakes and losses reach a huge scale.
jjk-manga.author: Gege Akutami

cdesc.Mahito: A curse born from humanity's hatred, a soul manipulator with a childlike laugh and cruel experiments.

one-punch-man.summary: A hero who has become so strong he beats any opponent with a single punch is bored to death for lack of a real challenge. This manga twists superhero tropes with absurd humor and spectacular fights.
one-punch-man.author: ONE (story), Yusuke Murata (art)

tokyo-ghoul.summary: An ordinary student is turned into a half-human, half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter, forcing him to navigate a hidden world where ghouls feed on humans while fighting to keep his humanity.
tokyo-ghoul.author: Sui Ishida

cdesc.Touka Kirishima: A protective ghoul hiding her vulnerability behind an explosive temper.
cdesc.Hide Nagachika: The hero's cheerful, chatty best friend, unfailingly devoted and surprisingly perceptive.

cdesc.Juuzou Suzuya: A young investigator with scars and a strange smile, whimsical and formidable in battle, with a tormented childhood.

monster.summary: A brilliant surgeon sees his career ruined after choosing to save a child's life rather than a mayor's. Years later, he discovers the child has become a manipulative serial killer, and sets out after him.
monster.author: Naoki Urasawa

cdesc.Johan Liebert: A man of chilling charisma whose origins and motives long remain a mystery.

fma-manga.summary: The original work following the Elric brothers in their search for the Philosopher's Stone, the basis of the faithful Brotherhood anime, with an ending planned by the author from the start.
fma-manga.author: Hiromu Arakawa

cdesc.Envy: A shapeshifting homunculus consumed by jealousy, who despises humans and sows discord with a cruel laugh.

slam-dunk.summary: A hot-headed high schooler joins his school's basketball team to impress a girl and, despite himself, discovers a real passion for the sport. This sports manga classic follows his technical and personal growth within a close-knit team.
slam-dunk.author: Takehiko Inoue

cdesc.Hanamichi Sakuragi: A fiery, clumsy beginner whose progress in basketball is meteoric.

uzumaki.summary: A small coastal town slowly sinks into a curse obsessed with the shape of the spiral, which infects bodies, minds and even the town's architecture. A masterpiece of psychological and body horror by Junji Ito.

golden-kamuy.summary: In early 20th-century Hokkaido, a hardened war veteran teams up with a young Ainu girl to find a hidden gold treasure whose location is tattooed on the skin of escaped prisoners, in a treasure hunt as brutal as it is historical.
golden-kamuy.author: Satoru Noda

cdesc.Saichi Sugimoto: A war veteran nicknamed "Immortal", determined to find the treasure for a personal cause.
cdesc.Asirpa: A young Ainu huntress with ancestral knowledge, the expedition's indispensable guide.

cdesc.Kiroranke: A taciturn, experienced Ainu who guides the gold hunters with deep knowledge of nature and a painful secret.
cdesc.Retar: The young Ainu girl's loyal white wolf, who hunts alongside the heroine as a precious partner.

20th-century-boys.summary: A group of childhood friends discovers that the imaginary global conspiracy game they invented as kids is coming true exactly as planned, orchestrated by a mysterious masked leader. An ensemble thriller spanning several decades.
20th-century-boys.author: Naoki Urasawa

cdesc.Kenji Endo: A former musician who unwillingly becomes the only one able to recognize "Friend"'s plan from their childhood.

akira.summary: In a cyberpunk Neo-Tokyo ravaged by gangs, a young biker watches his best friend develop uncontrollable psychic powers linked to a secret government experiment. A founding work of modern Japanese science fiction.
akira.author: Katsuhiro Otomo

cdesc.Kaneda Shotaro: The leader of a biker gang, determined to save his friend from government experiments.
cdesc.Tetsuo Shima: Kaneda's best friend, whose newly awakened psychic powers slowly consume him.

pluto.summary: A robot detective investigates a series of murders targeting the world's most advanced robots, each killed in a way strangely evoking devil's horns. A dark, philosophical reinterpretation of a manga classic.
pluto.author: Naoki Urasawa

blue-lock.summary: After a painful World Cup defeat, the Japanese football federation locks three hundred promising strikers inside a ruthless training center, where only one will survive to become the selfish goal scorer the national team needs.
blue-lock.author: Muneyuki Kaneshiro

cdesc.Yoichi Isagi: A striker haunted by a past failure, forced to redefine his playstyle to survive the program.

jojo-manga.summary: The original work following several generations of the Joestar family across the world and through the ages, fighting supernatural forces with spiritual manifestations called Stands. A cult saga instantly recognizable for its flamboyant visual style.
jojo-manga.author: Hirohiko Araki

made-in-abyss-manga.summary: The original work following the exploration of a gigantic chasm full of treasures and unspeakable horrors, with a deceptively childlike art style hiding a fearsomely dark story.

kingdom.summary: In ancient China, torn apart by wars between rival kingdoms, a young orphan who dreams of becoming the greatest general in history rises through the military ranks alongside a young king determined to unify the land.
