cdesc.Soshiro Hoshina: The 3rd Division's very strong, laid-back vice-captain.
cdesc.Isao Shinomiya: The commander-in-chief of the Defense Force, a formidable warrior.
cdesc.Gen Narumi: Captain of the 1st Division, considered the most powerful fighter.

sakamoto-days-manga.summary: Taro Sakamoto, a legend among hitmen, retired to run a convenience store with his family, which made him put on a lot of weight. When his past catches up with him, he must defend his peaceful life with the help of his friends.
sakamoto-days-manga.author: Yuto Suzuki

cdesc.Taro Sakamoto: A legendary former hitman and family man turned imposing shopkeeper.
cdesc.Shin Asakura: A telepath and former hitman who becomes Sakamoto's assistant.
cdesc.Lu Xiaotang: A strong, determined young Chinese assassin with an acrobatic martial arts style.
cdesc.Hana Sakamoto: Sakamoto's wife, who knows he was a hitman.
cdesc.Heisuke Mashimo: A former organization killer with an acrobatic, fluid fighting style.
cdesc.Nagumo: Sakamoto's former colleague, formidable in battle.
cdesc.Slur: A manipulative, unscrupulous former killer who started the vendetta against Sakamoto.

mashle-manga.summary: In a world where magic determines social status, Mash Burnedead is born without any magic but with colossal physical strength. To live in peace with his adoptive family, he enters a magic academy and must become a "Divine Visionary".
mashle-manga.author: Hajime Komoto

cdesc.Mash Burnedead: A boy with no magic but prodigious physical strength, passionate about cream puffs.
cdesc.Finn Ames: Mash's best friend, a mage with a brave heart and evolving magic.
cdesc.Lance Crown: An elite academy mage, a protective, loyal brother.
cdesc.Dot Barrett: An ambitious, impulsive lightning mage who joins Mash's team.
cdesc.Lemon Irvine: A caring classmate and friend of the protagonists.
cdesc.Abel Walker: A proud mage able to manipulate magic, Mash's rival.
cdesc.Rayne Ames: Finn's older brother, a formidable mage tied to the academy's organization.
cdesc.Innocent Zero: A tyrannical mage whose ambition is to impose absolute rule over the world.
cdesc.Cuore Burnedead: Mash's adoptive father, who lives as a recluse.

undead-unluck-manga.summary: Andy is immortal and Fuko carries bad luck that kills anyone who touches her. Together they team up to find a way to die for one and to touch others for the other. Their quest leads them to the Union, an organization of people with strange powers.
undead-unluck-manga.author: Yoshifumi Tozuka

cdesc.Andy: An immortal man whose body regenerates from every wound, longing to die.
cdesc.Fuko Izumo: A girl cursed with bad luck that makes her dangerous to those around her.
cdesc.Juiz Seiwa: An unbendingly serious, very powerful Union member who joins Andy and Fuuko.
cdesc.Shen Xiaotian: A former enemy turned ally with a disruptive power.
cdesc.Billie: A Union fighter with a teleportation power.
cdesc.Gina Hel: A Union member and devoted assistant.
cdesc.Rip: A Union member with the power to skip through time.
cdesc.Nico: A Union member with a strong sense of duty.
cdesc.Victor: The series' central adversary, a cold and unpredictable mind.

fire-force-manga.summary: In a world where some humans spontaneously combust and become monsters called Infernals, the Special Fire Force fights to stop them. Shinra Kusakabe, nicknamed "the Devil", joins Company 8 to uncover the mystery of the fire that killed his family.
fire-force-manga.author: Atsushi Ohkubo

cdesc.Shinra Kusakabe: A young man whose feet produce flames, who dreams of becoming a hero.
cdesc.Arthur Boyle: A self-proclaimed knight of Company 8 who wields a plasma sword.
cdesc.Maki Oze: A Company 8 pyrokinetic, impetuous and loyal.
cdesc.Iris: Company 8's sister, a kind prayer leader tied to the mission of the Infernals.
cdesc.Akitaru Obi: Company 8's lieutenant, a former soldier with strong character.
cdesc.Sho Kusakabe: Shinra's older brother, central to the plot.
cdesc.Tamaki Kotatsu: A young Company 8 fire soldier who attracts mishaps.
cdesc.Benimaru Shinmon: Company 7's captain, an extremely powerful fighter.
cdesc.Joker: An unpredictable antagonist who attacks the Infernals.

noragami-manga.summary: Yato is a minor god without a shrine who takes any small job for five yen. Meeting Hiyori, a high school girl whose soul slips out of her body, and his weapon spirit Yukine changes his life as a wandering god.
noragami-manga.author: Adachitoka

cdesc.Yato: A wandering god without a shrine, both joker and serious, ready to do anything to be recognized.
cdesc.Hiyori Iki: A high school girl whose soul involuntarily slips out of her body since an accident.
cdesc.Yukine: A weapon spirit who becomes Yato's sacred weapon, with a painful past.
cdesc.Kazuma: Yato's Regalia, a former spirit with a noble, devoted character.
cdesc.Bishamon: A goddess of war with an army of sacred spirits.
cdesc.Kofuku: A cheerful, optimistic goddess of poverty and Yato's friend.
cdesc.Daikoku: Kofuku's Regalia, with a calm character.
cdesc.Nora: A masterless weapon spirit brought to light by Yato.
cdesc.Ebisu: A young god of luck and Yato's friend.

blue-exorcist-manga.summary: Rin Okumura learns he is the son of Satan and has inherited devastating blue flames. To fight his father, he decides to become an exorcist and enters True Cross Academy, where he reunites with his twin brother Yukio.
blue-exorcist-manga.author: Kazue Kato

cdesc.Rin Okumura: Satan's son with blue flames, impulsive and brave, who wants to become an exorcist.
cdesc.Yukio Okumura: Rin's twin brother, a gifted exorcist and academy teacher.
cdesc.Shiemi Moriyama: A gentle girl who studies plants and becomes an exorcist.
cdesc.Ryuji Suguro: An impetuous classmate and traditionally trained exorcist.
cdesc.Renzo Shima: A laid-back classmate and spy with a complex mind.
cdesc.Izumo Kamiki: A classmate with a link to fox spirits.
cdesc.Shiro Fujimoto: Rin and Yukio's adoptive father, a high-ranking exorcist.
cdesc.Mephisto Pheles: The academy's director, an eccentric, manipulative demon.
cdesc.Satan: The King of Demons, Rin's father and main enemy.

akame-ga-kill-manga.summary: Tatsumi, a young villager, travels to the capital to earn money and save his village. There he discovers the Empire's corruption and joins Night Raid, a group of assassins fighting the regime.
akame-ga-kill-manga.author: Takahiro / Tetsuya Tashiro

cdesc.Tatsumi: A naive but brave young warrior who joins Night Raid, wielder of the Imperial Arm Incursio.
cdesc.Akame: A silent assassin wielding the cursed sword Murasame, formidably strong.
cdesc.Leone: A cheerful Night Raid member, wielder of Lionelle.
cdesc.Mine: Night Raid's proud, hot-tempered sharpshooter, wielder of Pumpkin.
cdesc.Sheele: An absent-minded, lovable Night Raid member who wields the scissors Extase.
cdesc.Lubbock: A Night Raid member skilled at manipulating threads.
cdesc.Bulat: A former imperial soldier turned Night Raid member, Tatsumi's mentor.
cdesc.Esdeath: An Empire general with ice powers, cruel by nature and fascinated by Tatsumi.
cdesc.Najenda: Night Raid's leader, a former imperial general.

magi-manga.summary: In a world inspired by the Arabian Nights, the young magician Aladdin and his friend Alibaba explore mysterious dungeons that hold colossal powers. Their quest soon becomes entangled with politics and the struggle between great kingdoms.
magi-manga.author: Shinobu Ohtaka

cdesc.Aladdin: A young magician with a flute and turban, with immense magic and boundless curiosity.
cdesc.Alibaba Saluja: A big-hearted young adventurer determined to conquer dungeons and become a true hero.
cdesc.Morgiana: A fighter from the Fanalis people, with extraordinary physical strength and absolute loyalty.
cdesc.Sinbad: The charismatic king of Sindria and conqueror of seven dungeons, with complex motives.
cdesc.Judal: A provocative, powerful Magi serving the Kou Empire, who sees Aladdin as an opponent.
cdesc.Hakuryuu Ren: A Kou Empire prince marked by grief and driven by revenge.
cdesc.Kouen Ren: The Kou Empire's eldest prince, an ambitious, respected strategist who dreams of unifying the world.
cdesc.Kougyoku Ren: A sensitive, devoted Kou princess who matures over the course of the story.

hellsing-manga.summary: The Hellsing Organization protects England from vampires and other creatures of the night. Its most fearsome weapon is Alucard, an ancient vampire in its service, facing a Nazi enemy preparing for total war.
hellsing-manga.author: Kohta Hirano

cdesc.Alucard: A vampire of near-absolute power, the Hellsing family's sadistic, loyal servant.
cdesc.Integra Hellsing: The unbending head of the Hellsing Organization, who commands Alucard with iron authority.
cdesc.Seras Victoria: A policewoman turned vampire who fights to keep her humanity.
cdesc.Walter C. Dornez: An impeccable butler and former vampire hunter with deadly wires.
cdesc.Alexander Anderson: A fanatical Iscariot priest, a fearsome regenerator and Alucard's sworn enemy.
cdesc.Major: The leader of the Last Battalion, who dreams of an endless war.
cdesc.Luke Valentine: A cold, sadistic Last Battalion vampire.
cdesc.Jan Valentine: Luke's brother, an unstable, cruel vampire serving the Major.

kaiji-manga.summary: Kaiji Ito, a young man with no future buried in debt, agrees to board the ship Espoir to play high-stakes games, at the risk of losing everything. Cunning, psychology and betrayal dominate these high-tension duels.
kaiji-manga.author: Nobuyuki Fukumoto

cdesc.Kaiji Itou: A penniless gambler with a keen sense of intuition and bluff.
cdesc.Yukio Tonegawa: A cruel Teiai executive who orchestrates dangerous games to humiliate the losers.
cdesc.Kazutaka Hyoudou: The rich, ruthless boss of the Teiai group, who feeds on gamblers' misery.
cdesc.Yuuji Endou: The cunning, devious head of a loan company for gamblers, sometimes Kaiji's ally.
cdesc.Tetsuo Ishida: A gambler with a murky past who teams up with Kaiji in a high-risk game.
cdesc.Kazuya Hyoudou: The Teiai boss's son, an arrogant heir who confronts Kaiji.

nana-manga.summary: Two young women both named Nana, with opposite personalities, meet on the train to Tokyo and become roommates. One dreams of making it in music with her punk band, the other is looking for love and meaning in her life.
nana-manga.author: Ai Yazawa

cdesc.Nana Osaki: Black Stones' punk singer, strong on the surface but fragile in love.
cdesc.Nana Komatsu: Nicknamed Hachi, a naive, sentimental young woman who moves to Tokyo.
cdesc.Ren Honjo: Trapnest's guitarist, Nana Osaki's former love and a rock scene figure.
cdesc.Nobuo Terashima: Black Stones' cheerful, loyal bassist and Hachi's close friend.
cdesc.Shinichi Okazaki: Black Stones' young drummer, sensitive and lovable.
cdesc.Takumi Ichinose: Trapnest's charismatic, manipulative bassist, tied to both heroines.
cdesc.Yasushi Takagi: Black Stones' former manager and guitarist, discreet and mature.
cdesc.Reira Serizawa: Trapnest's singer, with a painful past and a turbulent love life.

ouran-manga.summary: Haruhi Fujioka, a scholarship student at prestigious Ouran Academy, breaks an outrageously expensive vase and must pay it back by joining the Host Club, a circle of handsome boys who entertain their admirers. Her androgynous looks lead her to work there as a host.
ouran-manga.author: Bisco Hatori

cdesc.Haruhi Fujioka: A pragmatic, hard-to-impress high school girl who ends up a club host by accident.
cdesc.Tamaki Suoh: The Host Club's president, an eccentric romantic who sees himself as Haruhi's father.
cdesc.Kyoya Ootori: The club's vice-president, a calculating strategist who manages the finances.
cdesc.Hikaru Hitachiin: One of the club's mischievous twins, very attached to his brother.
cdesc.Kaoru Hitachiin: The other twin, more composed, Hikaru's accomplice in their pranks.
cdesc.Mitsukuni Haninozuka: A childlike-looking senior who is actually a martial arts expert.
cdesc.Takashi Morinozuka: Mitsukuni's silent cousin and protector, also a martial arts champion.
cdesc.Renge Houshakuji: A passionate games and manga fan who becomes the Host Club's manager.

horimiya-manga.summary: Kyoko Hori, a popular high school girl, has a busy family life outside of class. She discovers that Izumi Miyamura, a classmate known as gloomy and quiet, hides piercings and tattoos. Growing closer changes their daily lives.
horimiya-manga.author: HERO / Daisuke Hagiwara

cdesc.Kyoko Hori: A brilliant, popular high school girl who runs her household and looks after her little brother.
cdesc.Izumi Miyamura: A boy who looks unremarkable but has piercings and tattoos, and a gentle nature.
cdesc.Tooru Ishikawa: Hori's childhood friend, loyal and somewhat impulsive.
cdesc.Yuki Yoshikawa: Hori's cheerful, direct friend, passionate about sports.
cdesc.Remi Ayasaki: A kind classmate very attached to Miyamura.
cdesc.Kakeru Sengoku: A charming-looking senior who is interested in Hori.
cdesc.Shu Iura: A gentle classmate and Miyamura's close friend.
cdesc.Sakura Kouno: An energetic classmate and Hori's friend.

my-dress-up-darling-manga.summary: Wakana Gojo, a lonely high schooler passionate about traditional hina dolls, bonds with Marin Kitagawa, an outgoing classmate who loves cosplay. He decides to make her costumes, and their collaboration turns into a sincere friendship.
my-dress-up-darling-manga.author: Shinichi Fukuda

cdesc.Marin Kitagawa: An enthusiastic, frank high school girl passionate about cosplay and games.
cdesc.Wakana Gojo: A shy high schooler who wants to become a hina doll master and sews with talent.
cdesc.Shinju Inui: A rich, popular classmate who also loves cosplay and becomes Marin's friend.
cdesc.Sajuna Inui: Shinju's older sister, a cosplay fan herself.
cdesc.Shoyo Gojo: Wakana's grandfather, a hina doll craftsman.

grand-blue-manga.summary: Iori Kitahara moves to a coastal town to study at university. He gets roped into the diving club, where people drink far more than they dive. Absurd humor and situations worthy of the sea.
grand-blue-manga.author: Kenji Inoue / Kimitake Yoshioka

cdesc.Iori Kitahara: A party-loving student who often loses his clothes, to the dismay of those around him.
cdesc.Kohei Imamura: Iori's cousin, a good-looking student who is actually an idol and manga fan.
cdesc.Chisa Kotegawa: A serious, gentle student with a strong personality, red with anger at the club's excesses.
cdesc.Nanaka Kotegawa: Chisa's younger sister, passionate about diving and very attached to Iori.
cdesc.Azusa Hamaoka: The dive shop manager, a longtime friend of the club.

solo-leveling-manga.summary: In a world where portals open onto monster-filled dungeons, Jin-Woo Sung is considered the weakest hunter. After an ordeal that nearly costs him his life, he gains a strange system that lets him grow stronger without limit.
solo-leveling-manga.author: Chugong / Dubu / Jang Sung-rak

cdesc.Jin-Woo Sung: An E-rank hunter who becomes the most powerful thanks to a system that lets him level up.
cdesc.Hae-In Cha: An S-rank hunter with a keen sense of smell for auras, drawn to Jin-Woo.
cdesc.Gun-Hee Go: The president of the Hunter Association, an experienced, respected mentor.
cdesc.Thomas Andre: An American national-level hunter with immense physical strength.
cdesc.Yoonho Baek: An S-rank hunter and guild master, Jin-Woo's loyal ally.
cdesc.Jin-Ah Sung: Jin-Woo's little sister, the one he fights for.
cdesc.Beru: An ant soldier, powerful and devoted to Jin-Woo.
cdesc.Ryuji Goto: A Japanese guild master, a high-ranking hunter.

real-manga.summary: After accidents or injuries, three men come together through wheelchair basketball, which becomes a way to rebuild themselves. A realistic portrait of disability, the will to live and sportsmanship.
real-manga.author: Takehiko Inoue

cdesc.Tomomi Nomiya: A former high school athlete left paraplegic after an accident, angry at the world.
cdesc.Kiyoharu Togawa: An athlete who lost a leg, a former sprinter with a brusque temper.
cdesc.Hisanobu Takahashi: A young man in a wheelchair since an accident, looking for his place in basketball.

ashita-no-joe.summary: Joe Yabuki, a young delinquent from the Tokyo slums, is spotted by former boxer Danpei Tange, who trains him. A boxing career opens up for him, marked by grueling fights.
ashita-no-joe.author: Asao Takamori / Tetsuya Chiba

cdesc.Joe Yabuki: A rebellious young orphan turned boxer, ready to give everything in the ring.
cdesc.Danpei Tange: An alcoholic former boxer who trains Joe with passion.
cdesc.Tooru Rikishi: Joe's boxing rival, as relentless in his efforts as he is.
cdesc.Yoko Shiraki: A wealthy young woman who supports Joe and is tied to his journey.
cdesc.Carlos Rivera: A renowned Venezuelan boxer Joe faces in a decisive fight.
cdesc.Jose Mendoza: The Mexican world champion, Joe's ultimate rival.

blue-giant.summary: Dai Miyamoto, a high schooler from Sendai, discovers jazz and decides to become the best saxophonist in the world. He moves to Tokyo, where he forms a trio with a pianist and a drummer.
blue-giant.author: Shinichi Ishizuka

cdesc.Dai Miyamoto: A determined tenor saxophonist who practices every day on a riverbank.
cdesc.Yukinori Sawabe: A gifted, classically trained pianist who joins Dai's trio.
cdesc.Shunji Tamada: Dai's high school friend, a beginner drummer who improves by leaps and bounds.

tomie.summary: Tomie Kawakami is a beautiful girl who fascinates everyone who comes near her. Even dismembered, she regenerates, and her presence drives those who desire her to madness or murder. Short stories, each centered on one of her reincarnations.
tomie.author: Junji Ito

cdesc.Tomie Kawakami: An immortal girl who regenerates from her wounds and sows discord around her.
cdesc.Tsukiko Izumisawa: A high school girl who discovers Tomie's true nature in the first story.

gyo.summary: During a stay in Okinawa, Tadashi and his girlfriend Kaori see fish invading dry land on mechanical legs. A stench of death accompanies this plague as it spreads across the whole country.
gyo.author: Junji Ito

cdesc.Tadashi: A young man trying to protect his girlfriend from the invasion.
cdesc.Kaori: Tadashi's girlfriend, hypersensitive to smells, who slides into horror.

black-butler-manga.summary: Ciel Phantomhive, the Queen of England's watchdog, solves London's darkest cases with the help of Sebastian, his demon butler. A gothic manga where each investigation brings Ciel closer to the truth about the night that destroyed his family.
black-butler-manga.author: Yana Toboso

cdesc.Ciel Phantomhive: A young earl and the Queen's watchdog, in charge of Victorian England's criminal affairs, who made a pact with a demon for revenge.
cdesc.Sebastian Michaelis: Ciel's demonic butler, elegant, formidable and capable of anything, "for he is simply one hell of a butler."
cdesc.Elizabeth Midford: Ciel's fiancée, cheerful and obsessed with all things "cute", who hides real skill with a sword.
cdesc.Grell Sutcliff: A flamboyant reaper fascinated by Sebastian, who wields a chainsaw.
cdesc.Undertaker: An eccentric undertaker and Ciel's informant, with a mysterious past.
cdesc.Mey-Rin: The Phantomhive manor's maid, nearsighted but a sharpshooter when she takes her glasses off.
cdesc.Finnian: The manor's gardener, with superhuman strength and a big heart.
cdesc.Bardroy: The manor's cook, a former soldier who tends to blow everything up with his flamethrower.

food-wars-manga.summary: Soma Yukihira takes on the best students of Totsuki Academy in high-stakes cooking duels. A manga where every dish is a battle, with mouthwatering illustrations.
food-wars-manga.author: Yuto Tsukuda, Shun Saeki

cdesc.Souma Yukihira: The son of a neighborhood diner, an instinctive, inventive cook who never backs down from a challenge.
cdesc.Erina Nakiri: Heiress to the "God Tongue", with an exceptional palate and a haughty temper that slowly softens.
cdesc.Megumi Tadokoro: A shy, hard-working student from the countryside who gains confidence thanks to Soma.
cdesc.Jouichirou Yukihira: Soma's father, an outstanding cook who traveled the world and once attended Totsuki himself.
cdesc.Takumi Aldini: A precise, proud Italian cook, trained alongside his brother Isami.
cdesc.Ikumi Mito: A meat-specialist Totsuki student with a scrappy temper who grows close to Soma.
cdesc.Satoshi Isshiki: A member of Totsuki's Elite Ten, a talented and mysterious cook.
cdesc.Senzaemon Nakiri: Totsuki's director and Erina's grandfather, who imposes a highly selective system on the academy.

quintuplets-manga.summary: Futaro Uesugi has to tutor five identical sisters who refuse to learn. Over the high school years, one of them will become his future wife, and the manga keeps the mystery until the very end.
quintuplets-manga.author: Negi Haruba

cdesc.Fuutarou Uesugi: A brilliant but penniless high schooler hired as tutor to the five Nakano sisters, tasked with helping them pass their exams.
cdesc.Ichika Nakano: The eldest quintuplet, teasing and mature, who dreams of becoming an actress.
cdesc.Nino Nakano: The strong-willed second sister, a gifted cook and very protective of her family.
cdesc.Miku Nakano: The reserved third sister, passionate about Sengoku history, who develops a quiet attachment to Fuutarou.
cdesc.Yotsuba Nakano: The energetic, sporty fourth sister, who devotes herself to others.
cdesc.Itsuki Nakano: The youngest, studious and food-loving, who greatly admires her mother.
cdesc.Maruo Nakano: The quintuplets' father, a doctor heading a large hospital.

mushishi-manga.summary: Ginko, a traveling mushi master, meets people affected by mushi, primitive life forms on the edge of the visible. A manga of short, sensitive and poetic stories about nature and humanity's place in it.
mushishi-manga.author: Yuki Urushibara

cdesc.Ginko: A wandering white-haired, green-eyed Mushi Master who travels the land to study mushi and help the people they affect.
cdesc.Adashino: A doctor in a coastal village whom Ginko visits to sell mushi-related items he collects out of passion.
cdesc.Nui: A Mushi Master and the series' narrator, whose appearance closely resembles Ginko's because of her exposure to mushi.
cdesc.Tanyuu Karibusa: The fourth scribe of the Karibusa family, bearing a birthmark that holds a forbidden mushi.

dororo-manga.summary: Hyakkimaru, robbed of his body at birth by a demonic pact, hunts the 48 demons who hold each of its parts. With the thief Dororo, he crosses a war-torn feudal Japan in a classic by the master Osamu Tezuka.
dororo-manga.author: Osamu Tezuka

cdesc.Hyakkimaru: A boy born without a whole body, whose parts were given to demons by his father, and who takes them back one by one by killing them.
cdesc.Dororo: A clever, mischievous young street thief who decides to follow Hyakkimaru after seeing his swordsmanship.
cdesc.Tahoumaru Daigo: Hyakkimaru's younger brother and the lord's heir, torn between loyalty and truth.
cdesc.Kagemitsu Daigo: The lord of a domain ravaged by floods and famine, who makes a pact with demons to secure his power.
cdesc.Biwamaru: A blind wandering monk who takes Hyakkimaru under his wing.
cdesc.Mio: A young woman who takes in war orphans and crosses paths with Hyakkimaru.

to-your-eternity-manga.summary: Fushi, an immortal being who can copy whatever it touches, discovers love, friendship and loss through encounters spanning the ages. A heartbreaking manga about what it means to live, by the author of A Silent Voice.
to-your-eternity-manga.author: Yoshitoki Oima

cdesc.Fushi: An immortal being who takes the form of what it touches and learns to be human through encounters and losses.
cdesc.March: A girl who becomes a kind of adoptive mother to Fushi and teaches him the basics of human life.
cdesc.Parona: Ninannah's daughter and March's close friend, who looks out for her.
cdesc.Gugu: A young man from Takunaha, Fushi's sworn brother, who fights the Nokkers with him.
cdesc.Hayase: A former member of the guard force stationed in Yanome, who crosses Fushi's path.
cdesc.Tonari: A girl Fushi meets on Jananda Island, a member of Tonari's group.

detective-conan-manga.summary: Shrunk ten years younger, Shinichi Kudo investigates under the identity of Conan. One of the longest-running and most popular detective manga in Japan.
detective-conan-manga.author: Gosho Aoyama

cdesc.Conan Edogawa: A high school detective shrunk into a child after swallowing an experimental drug, who solves cases disguised as a little boy.
cdesc.Ran Mouri: Shinichi's childhood friend, a big-hearted karate champion who doesn't know Conan is Shinichi.
cdesc.Kogorou Mouri: Ran's absent-minded private detective father, whose deductions are actually whispered to him by Conan.
cdesc.Kaito Kuroba: A gentleman thief, alias Kaito Kid, who defies the police with spectacular stunts.
cdesc.Ai Haibara: A former Organization chemist, also shrunk, who watches over Conan with deadpan humor.
cdesc.Heiji Hattori: The high school detective of the West, Shinichi's rival and friend, with a strong Kansai accent.

initial-d-manga.summary: Takumi Fujiwara, a tofu delivery boy, becomes a legendary drift racer on Japan's mountain passes. A cult manga for fans of cars, mechanics and night racing.
initial-d-manga.author: Shuuichi Shigeno

cdesc.Takumi Fujiwara: A high schooler who delivers tofu every morning in the mountains and has unknowingly become an exceptional mountain-pass driver.
cdesc.Itsuki Takeuchi: Takumi's talkative, not-always-reliable best friend, who works at the gas station.
cdesc.Kouichirou Iketani: A driver friend of Takumi, passionate about cars and leader of the Night Kids.
cdesc.Ryousuke Takahashi: Leader of the Red Suns, a cerebral driver in a Mazda RX-7 FC and a road strategist.
cdesc.Bunta Fujiwara: Takumi's father, a legendary former driver who keeps a mysterious silence about his past.
cdesc.Keisuke Takahashi: Ryosuke's younger brother, an impetuous RX-7 FD driver with an explosive temper.

bungo-stray-dogs-manga.summary: Detectives with powers inspired by great writers face the Yokohama mafia. A manga mixing investigations, fights and literary references.
bungo-stray-dogs-manga.author: Kafka Asagiri, Sango Harukawa

cdesc.Osamu Dazai: A gifted Agency detective and former mafia member whose power nullifies others' abilities.
cdesc.Ryuunosuke Akutagawa: A Port Mafia member and Dazai's former pupil who wields a deadly cloak.
cdesc.Atsushi Nakajima: An orphan turned Agency member, able to transform into a white tiger.
cdesc.Doppo Kunikida: A perfectionist Agency member, always armed with his notebook and his ideals.
cdesc.Ranpo Edogawa: A detective with lightning-fast deduction and no power, who solves cases in the blink of an eye.
cdesc.Chuuya Nakahara: A Port Mafia executive able to manipulate gravity, Dazai's former partner.

ajin-manga.summary: Kei Nagai becomes the authorities' target when he discovers he is an immortal ajin. A dark seinen full of duels and twists.
ajin-manga.author: Gamon Sakurai, Tsuina Miura

cdesc.Satou: A murderous Ajin and leader of the opposition, charismatic and fascinated by the war he wages on the state.
cdesc.Kei Nagai: A brilliant high schooler who becomes an Ajin after an accident and is hunted by the government.
cdesc.Kaito: Kei's childhood best friend, who stays by his side despite the danger.
cdesc.Izumi Shimomura: A government employee who hunts Ajin and gets caught up in Kei's fate.

chihayafuru-manga.summary: A sports manga about karuta, where every game of poetry cards becomes a duel of wits and memory.
chihayafuru-manga.author: Yuki Suetsugu

cdesc.Chihaya Ayase: A high school girl passionate about competitive karuta, who dreams of becoming Queen and reuniting her childhood friends.
cdesc.Taichi Mashima: Chihaya's childhood friend, a brilliant student who pushes himself at karuta out of love and rivalry.
cdesc.Shinobu Wakamiya: The karuta Queen, a nearly invincible player with a fragile appearance.
cdesc.Arata Wataya: Chihaya's childhood friend, a talented player who almost gave up karuta.
